_note: Grid outage tracker (scripts/grid.mjs). open_customers: unplanned customers out in one operator region that opens an incident; close_customers: below this (and no grid level) for close_after collections in a row closes it. research_customers: peak that asks for a cause check (big); research_suspicious_customers: lower peak that asks for one when the operator's cause reads cyber, hack, malware, ransom, unknown or under investigation. levels: the grid level per signal source that asks for a check (Eskom load-shedding stage, ERCOT EEA level, AEMO LOR level). retry_hours and max_tries are used by scripts/grid-desk.mjs. The owner may change any of these. show_customers: every single outage with at least this many customers (accounts, not people) is drawn on the map with its location, besides the incidents (owner, 2026-11-19: anything over 100).
